latency_methodology.dense: Embedding + dense search + dense document conversion. Component latency, not an independent execution.
latency_methodology.bm25: BM25 scoring/ranking + BM25 document conversion. Component latency, not an independent execution.
latency_methodology.hybrid: Total warm retrieval latency returned by retrieve_hybrid(), including embedding, dense search, BM25, conversions, and RRF.
latency_methodology.hybrid_reranker: Hybrid retrieval latency + CrossEncoder reranker stage. The reranker stage includes pair construction, model prediction, and sorting of all unique page candidates.
latency_methodology.warmup: Warm-up executions are excluded from evaluation metrics and latency statistics.
